title: Wisteria Potion Workshop
description: A woman with glasses and a red scarf stands behind a green wooden apothecary counter, carefully pouring liquid from a bottle into a glowing vial. The scene is set in an enchanting outdoor pavilion overgrown with purple wisteria, with floating lanterns, scattered parchment notes, and framed paintings of winding paths leaning against the counter.
prompt: A mystical outdoor apothecary stall covered in hanging purple wisteria vines, a middle-aged woman with glasses and red scarf stands behind a dark green wooden counter filled with potion bottles, jars, and scrolls. She is pouring a glowing blue liquid. Red and blue paper lanterns float in the air with purple magical smoke. Framed landscape paintings and scattered handwritten notes lie on the golden path. Soft fantasy atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
